newsitem.title: CHINA: China state firms' losses up 5.4 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: China state firms' losses up 5.4 pct in January.

text.p: China's state-owned enterprises covered in the national budget registered losses of 6.16 billion yuan ($742.2 million) in January, up 5.4 percent from the same month last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The top three loss-making provinces were Jiangsu, Liaoning and Jilin, Xinhua said, quoting the State Statistical Bureau.
The eastern coastal province of Jiangsu registered losses of 386 million yuan, up four percent, it said.
Liaoning in the northeast posted losses of 312 million yuan, down 17.2 percent, while neighbouring Jilin saw losses jump 75 percent to 259 million yuan, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
